backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Cerebral Physique backend, defining data types (Exercise, BlogPost, Membership, etc.) and state maps for a fitness platform with blob storage, authorization, Stripe, and HTTP outcall mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features related to fixing the WorkoutLibraryPage exercise filtering/grouping bug and auditing useQueries.ts hooks to ensure correct muscle group data mapping.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes for components, pages, hooks, and configuration files in the React frontend.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining how to build and deploy the app to the Internet Computer, find the live .icp0.io canister URL, and set up a custom domain.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for connecting a custom domain (cerebralphysique.com) to the Internet Computer deployment via GoDaddy or Cloudflare DNS configuration.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including sidebar, chart, and UI component variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the React app entry point with TanStack Router, React Query, and theme provider setup, registering all page routes under a shared Layout root.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: A reusable button component that copies a given text string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback for older browsers, showing a toast notification on success.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Creator dashboard panel for managing Amazon affiliate products, supporting add, edit, and delete operations via dialogs with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin UI component for creating, editing, publishing, and deleting blog posts, including SEO fields and media URL management via a reusable UrlArrayInput component.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting exercises with fields for muscle group, equipment type, cues, and media URLs.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: Admin UI component for viewing and editing muscle group card metadata (title, description, image URLs) via a dialog form.
frontend/src/components/creator/Nutritio: Admin UI component for creating, editing, publishing, and deleting nutrition articles with media URL management and member-only access control.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component rendering brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, resource links, and legal/copyright text in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with desktop and mobile menus, Internet Identity authentication (login/logout), and conditional links for admin and authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a Header, Footer, MusicPlayer, and a router Outlet for child page content.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button component that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a $24.99/month membership and redirects the user to the Stripe-hosted payment page.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Floating background music player with autoplay (with browser-policy fallback), play/pause, mute, and volume controls rendered as a fixed bottom-right widget.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control if a token is present, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand store with persistence for managing a music player's play/pause state, volume, and mute settings, plus a convenience hook that exposes the store's actions and state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for fetching and mutating backend data including exercises, blog posts, user profiles, memberships, and admin checks via an actor interface.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light/dark theme CSS variables (using OKLCH colors), custom brand color utilities (neon-purple, deep-blue), scrollbar styles, and smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query, Internet Identity authentication provider, and the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page presenting the founder's story, brand philosophy, and feature highlights using hero sections, cards, and imagery with gradient overlays.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Affiliate store page that fetches and displays Amazon product recommendations in a grid with affiliate disclosure, loading states, and external purchase links.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Blog listing page that fetches published post previews, shows membership-gated content indicators, and provides an admin link to the creator dashboard for managing posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Displays a single blog post by ID, handling loading/not-found states, membership-gated content, and a media gallery supporting images, YouTube, Vimeo, and raw video URLs.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Static contact page showing support and general inquiry email addresses along with quick-navigation buttons to key site sections like Programs, Workout Library, Shop, and Dashboard.
Admin-only dashboard page that renders tabbed management panels for exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, nutrition content, and the affiliate store, with auth and permission guards.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Instructional page guiding admins through connecting a custom domain to the Internet Computer canister, displaying the live canister ID and DNS configuration steps.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Marketing landing page featuring a hero section, a fitness quote banner, and a core-principles card grid highlighting Mind-Muscle Connection, Heart, Dumbbell, and Breathwork pillars.
Displays a single nutrition article by ID with membership-gated full content, loading skeletons, error handling, and an embedded media gallery for images and videos.
frontend/src/pages/NutritionPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published nutrition article previews with member-only locking, a hero section, and an admin link to the creator dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Shows a payment failure screen with options to retry (navigate to dashboard) or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Verifies a Stripe checkout session by ID, invalidates membership cache on success, and displays loading/success/failure states accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Marketing page listing training programs with a hero section, a featured 7-day challenge card, and purchase buttons that show a coming-soon toast.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing membership status and profile info, with a profile-setup dialog on first login and a membership checkout button for non-members.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Workout library page that groups exercises by muscle group with collapsible sections, member-only locking, and expandable exercise cards showing images and video embeds.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, fonts, animations, and enabling typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a fitness app bug fix task where muscle group sections in WorkoutLibraryPage incorrectly display zero exercises due to data mapping/filtering issues.
